name: Energy, Oil & Gas
summary: Licences, permits and contractor relationships shape what an energy business can do and when.
needs: Identify sector licences and permits early, before operations or contracts depend on them
Keep contracts with vendors, partners and contractors documented and managed
Maintain employer registrations and compliance records for field and office staff
note: Sector-specific regulators (for example NUPRC, NMDPRA and NERC) are covered under our Regulatory Compliance & Licensing service.
